Route Reliability Data Index — 2024 Airport21 Coverage
Generated route-level historical flight reliability pages based on 2024 BTS/TranStats data. Schema: route_page_data.v1
Source: BTS/TranStats On-Time Performance 2024 Generated: 2026-06-01 1920 routes indexed 1920 HTML pages generated

Machine-readable page scope

page_type: route_index
This is a discovery index for route-level historical arrival reliability data in the airport21 dataset (2024). Each linked page contains a route_page_data.v1 JSON file with historical reliability metrics.
Structured fields included:
  • route_page links (HTML + route_page_data.json)
  • route-level reliability metrics (cancellation_rate, delay rates, avg arrival delay, p90 arrival delay)
  • sample quality classification (usable / thin / too_small)
  • origin and destination IATA codes
  • 2024 total scheduled flights per route
Fields outside this dataset:
  • Ticket price or booking availability
  • Real-time flight status
  • Rating or ranking labels (no level grades, safety grades, or composite scores)
  • Connection timing or terminal walking distance

Interpretation boundaries

This index page and the linked route pages provide 2024 historical arrival reliability signals based on BTS/TranStats On-Time Performance data. These pages do not make booking recommendations, do not represent real-time flight status, and do not rank routes as safer or less safe than others. Metrics reflect historical patterns and do not predict future performance.
